description: Source code for MultifileBlobCache class managing a file-based cache with hot cache and LRU eviction, including thread management for deferred disk writes.

classes.name: MultifileBlobCache
classes.description: Manages a file-based cache with hot cache, LRU eviction, and background thread for disk operations.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::MultifileBlobCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache, loading existing cache files, and starting worker thread.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::~MultifileBlobCache
methods.description: Destructor shutting down worker thread and cleaning up.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::set
methods.description: Adds an entry to cache and queues deferred disk write.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::get
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from cache, checking hot cache and loading from disk if necessary.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::finish
methods.description: Waits for all deferred writes to complete and cleans up hot cache.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::contains
methods.description: Checks if an entry exists in cache.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::getEntryStats
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a cache entry.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::addToHotCache
methods.description: Adds an entry to hot cache, evicting old entries if needed.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::removeFromHotCache
methods.description: Removes an entry from hot cache.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::applyLRU
methods.description: Removes least recently used entries until cache is under limit.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::trimCache
methods.description: Trims cache size by applying LRU eviction.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::processTask
methods.description: Executes a deferred task, such as writing to disk.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::processTasks
methods.description: Main worker thread function processing tasks until exit.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::queueTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the queue for worker thread.

methods.name: MultifileBlobCache::waitForWorkComplete
methods.description: Waits for all queued tasks to complete.
